source.label: thm:lowerbound
source.quote: Assume that the sampled action $b^t\sim\nu^t$ of the max-player at each iteration $t$ is never observed. Then, for any $p\in(0,2]$, no learning sequence can achieve simultaneously for all $2\times 2$ matrix games described above an $L^p$ last iterate convergence of \[f^t=\frac{4^{\frac{-1}{p}}}{118}t^{\frac{-1}{2+p}},\] even asymptotically.

results.notes: Quantity is the L^p norm of the exploitability gap of the last iterate (not regret). Impossibility even asymptotically.

conditions: max-player's sampled action is never observed

source.quote: Under the same assumption as Theorem~\ref{thm:lowerbound}, for any $p\in (2,\infty]$, no learning sequence can achieve simultaneously for all $2\times 2$ matrix games described above an $L^p$ last iterate convergence of \[f^t=\frac{1}{236}t^{\frac{-1}{4}},\] even asymptotically.

results.notes: L^p norm of exploitability gap of last iterate.

source.label: lemma:klbound
source.quote:
Let $	au\in (0,1]$. Taking $\eta^t=2/\pa{	au(t+1)}$ along with $\mu^{	au,1}=\mu^0$ and $
u^{	au,1}=
u^0$ the uniform policies gives with the above updates \[\E ra{\KL(\mu^{	au,\star},\mu^{	au,t})+\KL(
u^{	au,\star},
u^{	au,t})}\leq  rac{2(A+B)}{	au^2\,t}\] for all $t\in \N$.

results.notes: Expected KL distance between intermediate iterates and the regularized Nash equilibrium; holds for every t given fixed tau.

source.label: thm:regexp
source.quote: Let $T$ be a fixed horizon. Then, using regularization $\tau=\pa{\pa{{A+B}}/{T}}^{1/4}\sqrt{2/\pa{\log(A)+\log(B)}}$ and the learning rates $\eta^t= 2/(\tau(t+1))$ for all $t$, Algorithm~\ref{alg:regexp} guarantees \[\norm{EG(\mu^{T},\nu^T)}_2\leq 3\sqrt{2} \pa{\frac{A+B}{T}}^{1/4}\sqrt{\log(AB)}\, .\]

results.notes: L^2 norm of exploitability gap of the final iterate at known horizon T.

conditions: players share a common random seed
tuning: each A_i uses parameterization of Theorem thm:regexp with horizon T_i

source.label: thm:doubling
source.quote: Using Algorithm~\ref{alg:doubling} with, for each $\cA_i$, the algorithms and parameterization of Theorem~\ref{thm:regexp}, along with $T_i=32(i2^i)$ and $S_i=8(2^i)$, we obtain the bound \[\norm{EG(\mu^t,\nu^t)}_2\leq 30\pa{\frac{A+B}{t}}^{1/4}\sqrt{\log(AB)\log(t)}\] for any total number of iterations $t=T_1+...+T_{i-1}+j$.

results.notes: Anytime L^2 last-iterate bound on exploitability gap; T denotes current iteration t.
